svg.title: Viventium V0.5 single-glass-pane system map
svg.desc: A complete high-level view of Viventium as a local personal continuity system. The person's world enters through Connection and Presence, becomes a source-linked Life and portable Brain Pack, is selectively composed into one conscious mind with Feelings and independent cortices, acts through replaceable agent bodies and GlassHive, compounds through Automations and Sleep Growth, and returns useful continuity to the person's next moment.

g.text: One continuous mind across your life and the best AI.
Viventium owns the person-specific continuity. Frontier hosts keep their intelligence, tools, and integrations—and remain replaceable.
THE PERSON · ONE RELATIONSHIP, MANY DOORWAYS
Live once. Never re-teach your AI.
Talk, listen, approve, correct, and continue from wherever life is already happening.

svg.text: VIVENTIUM · THE LOCAL PERSONAL CONTINUITY SYSTEM
The small person-specific layer that must survive every model, provider, interface, and upgrade.
drop in/out · stay listening · only when useful · mute · anywhere access
Know what exists, what is allowed,

text.tspan: exact read · write · listen · presence scope

svg.text: Two sibling folders. Two different jobs.
LIFE/ · what Viventium knows and why
Current · Self · People/CRM · Health · Legal · Finance · Home
Insights · Skills · Tools · Services · Sources · Views · Archive
human-readable projections · evidence links · accepted truth · manifests
BRAIN_PACK/ · who Viventium is and how it thinks
portable doctrine, not secrets, indexes, databases, or live state
smallest relevant authorized Life + Brain + surface envelope
fast answer · synthesis · action · final user relationship
runs on the best selected native body
While the person is away, Viventium processes changes—not every unchanged byte—and leaves governed value for the next waking moment.
accepted Insights and proposals return to Life
Insights · Morning Brief · better next interaction
local-first · open formats · least privilege · provenance · health · receipts · pause · approval · correction · export · deletion
TRANSITION: reuse LibreChat APIs and working V0.4 services behind stable Viventium contracts; extract only when continuity, reliability, or UX improves.
LOCAL RUNTIME STATE · OUTSIDE LIFE + BRAIN PACK
credentials · provider sessions · databases · recall indexes · queues · caches · logs · Current Feelings · active runs
Proposed V0.5 product architecture · docs and review artifacts only · no runtime implementation claimed
SENSE → REMEMBER → UNDERSTAND → FEEL → THINK → ACT → LEARN → RETURN
